facts.business: Machino Plastics Limited manufactures plastic injection moulding parts and moulds & dies, primarily for the automotive sector with Maruti Suzuki India Limited as a key customer.
key_risks: Industry and service risks including economic risks like demand and supply chain, profitability and gestation period; service risks such as infrastructural facilities; market risks such as consumer preferences and distribution channels; business dynamics such as inflation/deflation; and competition risks such as cost-effectiveness.

Management and operational risks including risks to property; clear and well-defined work processes; changes in technology/upgradation; R&D risks; agency network risks; personnel and labour turnover risks; environmental and pollution control regulations; and locational benefits near metros.
Market risks including raw material rates; quantities, quality, suppliers, lead time, interest rate and forex risk.

Political risks including elections; war risks; country/area risks; insurance risks such as fire, strikes, riots and civil commotion, marine risks, cargo risks; and fiscal/monetary policy risks including taxation risk.
Credit risks including creditworthiness; risks in settlement of dues by clients; and provisions for doubtful and bad debts.
Liquidity risks including financial solvency and liquidity; borrowing limits; delays; cash/reserve management risks; and tax risks.

Disaster risks including natural calamities such as fires, floods, earthquakes; man-made risk factors arising under the Factories Act, Mines Act; and risk of failure of effective disaster management plans.
System risks including system capacity and system reliability risks; obsolescence risk; data integrity risk; and coordination and interface risk.
Legal risks including contract risks; contractual liabilities; fraud; judicial risks; and insurance risks.
Government policies including exemptions, import licenses, income tax and sales tax holidays, subsidies, tax benefits.
Financial risk including fluctuations in foreign currency rates, import duties and taxes, fluctuations in the price of various inputs including raw material supplies, and underutilized capacity.
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with Maruti Suzuki India Limited (sale of goods and services Rs 43,439.98 lakh in 2025-26, proposed Rs 70,000 lakh in 2026-27; tooling advance Rs 813.91 lakh in 2025-26, proposed Rs 10,000 lakh in 2026-27) and Suzuki Motor Corporation. Transactions also disclosed with Machino Transport Private Limited, Aditya Jindal, Sanjiivv Jindall, and other KMPs.
